svg.title: Underfitting, a good fit and overfitting with polynomial regression
svg.desc: Three panels show the same 20 noisy points and the true curve as a dashed grey line. A straight line (degree 1) misses the curve: underfitting. A degree 6 polynomial follows the curve: a good fit. A degree 15 polynomial passes close to every point but swings wildly between them: overfitting. Below each panel, the training and test errors are given.

g.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
g.text: Follows the trend, not the noise
Chases every point, swings between them
